title: Web Application
description:
**Job Title:** Web Application VAPT Tester

**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year (Bug Bounty Experience Mandatory)

**Salary:** ₹18,000 – ₹20,000 per month

**Location:** Chennai (On-site)

**Joining:** Immediate

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a passionate **Web Application VAPT Tester** to join our team . Candidates with strong interest in web security and hands-on bug bounty experience are encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Perform **Web Application Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT)**

· Identify and report vulnerabilities such as **SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, IDOR, etc.**

· Conduct **manual and automated security testing** of web applications

· Analyze findings and prepare detailed vulnerability reports

· Validate and retest security fixes

· Stay updated with the latest **web security threats and attack techniques**

**Required Skills:**

· Basic understanding of **Web Security Concepts** (OWASP Top 10)

· Hands-on experience in **Bug Bounty / Vulnerability Hunting (Mandatory)**

· Familiarity with tools like **Burp Suite, Nmap, Nikto, etc.**

· Knowledge of **HTTP/HTTPS, sessions, cookies, authentication mechanisms**

· Basic understanding of **Linux commands**

· Good analytical and problem-solving skills

**Eligibility:**

· Freshers are welcome

· Candidates must have **practical bug bounty experience (mandatory)**

· Certification is a plus but not mandatory

Good to have:

* Experience in Bug Bounty Hunting and responsible disclosure programs
* Hands-on experience with security labs such as DVWA, Juice Shop, PortSwigger Labs, Hack The Box, etc.
* Familiarity with mobile application security testing methodologies
* Knowledge of cloud security basics (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Relevant certifications such as CEH, eJPT, PNPT, OSCP, Security+, or similar

Eligibility

Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity / Information Technology / Computer Science or related field

Minimum 3 years of relevant cybersecurity or VAPT experience

Strong passion for application security and ethical hacking

Experience:

* in API Testing: 1 year (Preferred)
* in Web application testing: 1 year (Preferred)
* in mobile application testing: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹216,000.00 - ₹300,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Software Security Master
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity:**  
We are looking for a Software Security Master, a senior technical specialist responsible for enabling end-to-end software security across the development lifecycle.  
You will act as a security subject-matter expert for engineering teams, embedding security by design across architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, release, deployment, and operations. The role combines hands-on security engineering with threat modeling, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, risk management, security testing, and coaching.

**What you will do:**  
Drive security by design throughout the software development lifecycle.  
Conduct security and privacy risk assessments and threat modeling for products and features.  
Identify security risks, attack surfaces, sensitive data, trust boundaries, and required security controls.  
Translate identified risks into security requirements, mitigations, and verification activities.  
Promote secure coding, least privilege, defense in depth, secure authentication and authorization, and data protection practices.  
Perform or coordinate security design reviews, secure code reviews, and root-cause analysis of security issues.  
Integrate automated security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, vulnerability scanning, and secrets detection.  
Analyse CVEs and vulnerabilities affecting applications, platforms, containers, cloud services, operating systems, and third-party dependencies.  
Assess vulnerability severity, exploitability, impact, remediation actions, and target resolution dates.  
Coordinate remediation of critical and high-severity security findings and support risk acceptance where required.  
Plan and review penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and security verification activities.  
Ensure security risks, test results, remediation actions, and release evidence are properly documented and traceable.  
Provide security guidance for release readiness, deployment, and post-release activities.  
Coach developers, architects, testers, DevOps, SRE, and operations teams on secure development practices.  
Promote security awareness and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.  
Collaborate with product, engineering, architecture, privacy, legal, compliance, operations, and security stakeholders.

**The skills you bring:**  
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Security, or equivalent experience.  
Strong professional experience in Software Security, Product Security, Application Security, Secure Software Development, or DevSecOps.  
Hands-on experience with threat modeling, security risk assessments, secure coding, code reviews, vulnerability analysis, and security testing.  
Experience analysing CVEs and security findings across applications, operating systems, containers, cloud platforms, and third-party dependencies.  
Strong understanding of vulnerability remediation, mitigation, dependency management, and risk acceptance.  
Experience integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines.  
Knowledge of SAST, DAST, SCA, vulnerability scanning, secrets detection, and penetration testing.  
Understanding of APIs, distributed systems, IAM, network security, cryptography, and data protection.  
Experience with Kubernetes, containers, Cloud Native technologies, Infrastructure as Code, and security automation is preferred.  
Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as OWASP, CWE/SANS Top 25, NIST, and ISO 27001.  
Experience in telecommunications, cloud-native platforms, distributed systems, or complex software environments would be advantageous.  
Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills.  
Certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, OSCP, or GIAC would be an added advantage.

**Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

title: Junior Penetration Tester - Urapakkam (Near Kilambakkam / Vandalur)
description:

Cyber Security Engineer will develop and execute vulnerability and penetration test suites. Automate test suites where possible. Perform vulnerability and threat assessments with help from cybersecurity architects and PSRs. Assess vulnerability patches and identify the impact on the products. Analyses output of web application test scans to determine valid security issues.  
Meets with internal/external customers to analyze outputs from web application scans.  
Recommends remediation and mitigation strategies of security issues in web applications to customers.  
Bug bounty program participations

Web Vulnerability/Risk assessment processes  
OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities  
Report Writing

Manual Testing Tools:

Nessus  
Burp Suite  
SQL Map  
Nikto  
Metasploit

Certification:

Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
